display_name: Space - ISS / Earth-view technical plates (limited AI inserts)
locked_model: klein (config/image_engine.json -> model); prompt target klein, variant C

media_policy.note: AI illustrations may cover at most 15% of the runtime; real NASA footage is the primary visual. NASA insignia/emblems are excluded (14 CFR 1221).

line_style.name: technical schematic plate
line_style.prompt_phrase: technical schematic illustration, thin uniform strokes, flat fills, orthographic diagram
rules: flat fills only, no gradients, no reflections

camera_vocabulary.front: orthographic front elevation, full object centered
camera_vocabulary.side: orthographic side elevation, full object centered
camera_vocabulary.three_quarter: orthographic three-quarter elevation, near and far faces readable
camera_vocabulary.detail_crop: close orthographic crop on one component
camera_vocabulary.wide_context: wide schematic view of the assembly, small in frame

constraints.positive: clean image without text, text-free, no letters, no numerals, no watermark
constraints.negative: text, watermark, letters, numerals, label text

constraints.positive: schematic line drawing, not a photograph, not a photorealistic render
constraints.negative: photorealism, photograph, photorealistic render, cinematic lighting

constraints.positive: no emblems, no insignia, no flags, no logos, no agency marks
constraints.negative: emblem, insignia, flag, logo, NASA insignia, agency mark

constraints.positive: plain flat dark field, empty background
constraints.negative: starfield, milky way, nebula, dense stars

label_rule.label: Illustration
label_rule.gate: every AI cut carries the label; the AI share stays within the niche limit (max 15% of runtime)

anatomy_rule.rule: no creatures in this niche; structural parts are named in the prompt instead of anatomy counts

seed_policy.rule: one fixed seed per plate and view, recorded in the manifest; never reuse a seed for two subjects inside one batch

editorial_overlays_rule: labels, callouts, arrows, dimension lines and numbers are drawn in the editor, never by the image model
